about_the_game:
A comical adult fantasy shooting game based on fantasy! You become a female knight and stand against the approaching orc army. Use regular shots and special bullets such as fire and lightning to repel the orc army. If you lose to an orc, you will receive humiliating special training! If you endure the special training, you will power up and become stronger and stronger, and you will be able to crush the orcs!

  • Character Introduction

    main character:Lancelotte von Wallenstein.Commonly known as Lotte.She was a former nobleman, but was falsely accused by hers fiance's mistress and demoted to a remote fortress.

    Orc:A pig-faced monster.They launch an invasion of the kingdom for a certain purpose.

  • Game Introduction:

    ① An army of orcs will attack from the top of the screen, so fire magic bullets to fight them off.

    ②A magical barrier has been put up along the blue line.If this is destroyed or broken through, you will be defeated.

    ③If she is defeated, the orcs will give her special training to become stronger.

    Lottie's level will increase as she undergoes special training.Can she defeat the orcs and bring peace back to the land?

short_description: Fight off the approaching army of orcs who become female knights. If you lose to an orc, you will receive a humiliating training session.However, if the female knight endures this special training, she will become stronger and stronger. Can you survive the harsh training and defeat all the orcs?
